row.title: SEED-LAUNCH-1: seeds are launched, year-gated and probed live by the system
row.body: A standalone seed was broken (livechanges.js imported workers/core/substance outside seed/; two tests read platform files) and its year gate failed (yearsim.py main block ran before apply_observed existed; #1851 made the sweeper throw on non-2xx so the silent-drop drill failed). Fixed in seed/; bootstrap runs year_gate and verify_live; seedlaunch.py and seed-launch.yml launch a fresh seed and every seeded repo weekly on the ultrastable account; detector seed-launch.
